topic: Measuring Motion in Terms of Distance and Time
key_concepts: Force is a push or pull
Forces can initiate and influence motion
Motion is a change in position relative to a reference point
A reference point is a place or object used for comparison to determine motion
Distance is how far an object moves
The standard unit of distance is the meter, with centimeter and kilometer for smaller and
The basic unit of time is the second, with minute and hour for longer durations
Distance is a scalar quantity expressed by magnitude only
Measuring devices for distance include ruler, meter stick, tape measure, measuring wheel,
Metric prefixes such as kilo-, centi-, and milli- indicate scale
Speed is the distance traveled over a period of time
